language.title: Choose your language
language.description: You can change it at any time in Settings.

chat.title: Chat with AI on your own computer
chat.text: ChatonLM runs open AI models on your computer, with Ollama. Ask a question, attach a file or an image: your conversations are stored on your computer.

hub.title: Pick a model in the ModelHub
hub.text: A model is the AI you talk to. The ModelHub shows which ones fit your machine and downloads them in one click.

tools.title: Proofread and Study
tools.text: Proofread corrects or rephrases your texts and shows every change. Study turns any topic into a short course, with lessons and exercises.

voice.title: Speak and listen
voice.text: Dictate in any app with a shortcut, have answers read aloud, or talk hands-free in voice mode. Everything is set up in Settings.
